children: NN reported raised full-year 2026 guidance with net sales midpoint of $480 million and adjusted EBITDA midpoint of $63 million.
Raised 2026 net sales guidance to $470M–$490M (midpoint $480M), a 14% increase vs. 2025.
Raised 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $58M–$68M (midpoint $63M), a 29% increase vs. 2025.
Management cites strong demand in Data Center, Defense & Electronics, and Medical driving momentum and margin improvement.
New-business wins and ramp-ups: ~$100M midpoint of new wins for 2026; pipeline exceeds $100M for Data Center and >$750M overall.
Investing in growth capacity: ~60 new CNC machines at Wuxi plant, higher capex plans tied to $0.30 growth capex per peak sales dollar.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: NN Raises Full-Year 2026 Guidance; Midpoint Sales $480M, Adj. EBITDA $63M
